the SIMPLIFY trial, a multicentre, pragmatic, ‘real-practice’, non-inferior, open-label, randomized, clinical trial, will demonstrate that targeted simplification of antimicrobial therapy, from an empirical beta–lactam with antipsudomonal activity, is not inferior to a targeted narrow–spectrum antimicrobial in the treatment of bloodstream infections due to enterobacteriaceae.

the SIMPLIFY study is a randomized, multicenter, open-label, controlled, noninferiority clinical trial, designed to demonstrate the noninferiority of targeted antimicrobial therapy to broad-spectrum antimicrobials for the treatment of bloodstream infection caused by Enterobacteriaceaes.
